From e46b5a6470a5e2c8e1096f8f60887ac19949055b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2015 22:06:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: fix imx27 dtb build rule

The i.MX27 dtb build should be controlled by CONFIG_SOC_IMX27 rather
than CONFIG_SOC_IMX31.

Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Fixes: cb612390e546 ("ARM: dts: Only build dtb if associated Arch and/or SoC is enabled")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
index 86217db2937a..992736b5229b 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX25) += \
 	imx25-eukrea-mbimxsd25-baseboard-dvi-vga.dtb \
 	imx25-karo-tx25.dtb \
 	imx25-pdk.dtb
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
 	imx27-apf27.dtb \
 	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \
 	imx27-eukrea-mbimxsd27-baseboard.dtb \
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile`**
   - The line that previously added device tree blobs (dtbs) for the i.MX31 SoC has been changed to associate them with the i.MX27 SoC instead. Specifically, the line:
     ```make
     dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
     ```
     was modified to:
     ```make
     dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
     ```

### Relationships
- The modification in the `Makefile` corrects the build rule for the i.MX27 device tree blobs, ensuring that they are built when the configuration for the i.MX27 SoC is enabled (`CONFIG_SOC_IMX27`). This change addresses a bug where the build was incorrectly controlled by the i.MX31 configuration (`CONFIG_SOC_IMX31`), which is not appropriate for the i.MX27 dtbs. The patch is intended to ensure that the correct device tree files are included in the build process for the i.MX27 platform.

Here is the commit message:
ARM: dts: fix imx27 dtb build rule

The i.MX27 dtb build should be controlled by CONFIG_SOC_IMX27 rather
than CONFIG_SOC_IMX31.

Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Fixes: cb612390e546 ("ARM: dts: Only build dtb if associated Arch and/or SoC is enabled")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect association of the i.MX27 device tree blobs with the configuration for the i.MX31 SoC instead of the correct i.MX27 configuration. This misconfiguration led to the i.MX27 dtbs not being built when they should have been, resulting in potential failures when attempting to use the i.MX27 platform.

Here is the patch:
 	imx25-karo-tx25.dtb \
 	imx25-pdk.dtb
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
 	imx27-apf27.dtb \
 	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
	imx27-apf27.dtb \
	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \
```
Reason:
The i.MX27 device tree blobs (dtbs) were incorrectly associated with the configuration for the i.MX31 SoC, which meant that when the build system checked for the i.MX31 configuration, it would not build the i.MX27 dtbs, leading to potential failures when using the i.MX27 platform.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
	imx27-apf27.dtb \
	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \
```
Reason:
By changing the configuration from `CONFIG_SOC_IMX31` to `CONFIG_SOC_IMX27`, the build system is now correctly instructed to build the i.MX27 device tree blobs when the i.MX27 SoC is enabled, ensuring that the necessary dtbs are available for the platform.
